annotations.text:
Decision on the table: how much villager vocabulary should a hook keep?

All three are drawn from the real grids.ts — same role alphabet, same 8 hues, same INK. Pick a direction, not a polish level.

Settled already: ambient readout only, hooks ping the game, identity = the script path so tuning a flag keeps the same animal.
Open question on the burst: hooks on PostToolUse fire many times a minute. Unthrottled that is a strobe. Proposal is one burst per hook per ~2s, and a steady glow instead of bursts above that rate.
